full_judgment:
3. The respondents herein as the plaintiffs instituted Other Suit No. 80 of 1979 in the Second Court of the then Munsif, Chittagong against defendants-petitioners and others for partition of the suit land. By the judgment and order dated 08.11.1984 the trial Court decreed the suit in preliminary form. On an appeal therefrom the decree was modified to the effect that plaintiffs would get a saham to the extent of 0.0813 acre of land. Later, an Advocate Commissioner was appointed for effecting partition. On 08.04.2003, the Advocate Commissioner submitted his report which was rejected by the trial Court by the order dated 09.10.2004 which was reversed in revision by the judgment and order dated 22.03.2007 by the learned Additional District Judge, Third Court, Chittagong. 

 8. We have considered the submissions of the learned Advocate for the petitioners, the impugned judgment and the materials on record. Having considered the materials on record the High Court Division found that the Advocate Commissioner specified saham allotted to the plaintiffs pursuant to the preliminary decree passed in the suit and also on consideration of the  existing possession of the parties. The High Court Division noticed the defendants failed to disclose any facts about any conflict in allotment of saham to the plaintiffs. The High Court Division came to a finding that there was no legal mandate to reject the report of the Advocate Commissioner when he did not allot the quantum of share beyond the decree. The High Court Division, therefore, concluded that the revisional court below did not commit any error of law in reversing the order of the trial Court on appreciation of the materials on record.
